profile.summary: Experienced Implementation Manager with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry specific for Imports and Exports. Strong sales professional skills in Sales, Management, QuickBooks, Leadership, and Online Video Marketing.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Implementation – Training new clients how to use VISCO, schedule scrum call to ensure that projects are delivered on-time. Creating creative solutions to accomplish the ideal business solutions while maintaining the client's budget for the project. • Sales-Schedule and present product demonstrations. Schedule necessary follow up calls and demos as needed. Maintaining existing client relationships.
 • Marketing –Editing and creating social media marketing and content. Write case studies, blogs, and other content for our website. Creating video tutorials and how-to content for existing clients. 
• Training- Train newly hired implementation managers on best practices, the onboarding process, create support tools for existing and new implementation managers to ensure they have the necessary information to be able to successfully implement new clients. 
• Support – Assistant with incoming support requests via email and phone calls ranging from system bugs to data plugs, financial and inventory analysis, reviewing A/R and A/P, and system and financial audits. Help resolve open support requests via our project management software. 
• Development –Provide solutions to enhance default system functionality, SQL data scrubs, and uploads. Create query-based reports and alerts, provide testing and feedback on completed projects before presenting to the client.

positions.title: VP of Marketing /Sales
positions.description: As a VP of Marketing and Sales at VISCO I helped launch a marketing campaign for a software application Grapes: The Wine App designed for owners and sales reps in the wine industry to manage day to day task such as client management, wine profiles, inventory, and wine club members in the palm of their hand. This project included but was not limited to social media networking, logo design, preparation and attendance for conferences, and newsletters releases.

projects.title: Gheen: The CPA App
projects.description:
Client Portal for CPA firms.

The CPA App is the one stop app that allows CPAs to streamline communication with their clients by offering an interface to share the value they provide their clients. Fully integrated with your Client's QuickBooks Online.

projects.title: Grapes: The Wine App
projects.description:
A Simple Sales Solution for Wine Distributors and Retailer.

Track wine profile, characteristics, volume discount and registration info for each wine you sell. Attach labels, tasting summaries and any other documents. Track each sample provided, tastings hosted and track your wine club members too.
